title: Bringing Traits Into Scope
goal: Import a trait into scope so its extension methods can be resolved.
hints: Rust uses `use` to bring module items into scope.
Import the trait itself, not individual trait methods.
explanation: Rust requires the trait `Distance` to be in scope to call its method `to_meters`. `use convert::Distance;` imports the trait. Keywords like `import` or `using` from other languages cause syntax errors in Rust.
